description: This file manages container deletion logic within the Kubernetes kubelet component, including container sorting, deletion request handling, and container filtering based on status and creation time.

classes.name: podContainerDeletor
classes.description: Handles container deletion requests for a pod, maintaining a worker channel and a limit on containers to keep.

methods.name: newPodContainerDeletor
methods.description: Creates a new podContainerDeletor with a specified runtime and number of containers to keep.

methods.name: getContainersToDeleteInPod
methods.description: Returns a list of exited containers in a pod that should be deleted, ordered by creation time.

methods.name: deleteContainersInPod
methods.description: Issues container deletion requests for containers identified by filtering criteria.
